grh_84d04e47ca33042d5fdc.title: The New Adventures of Sherlock Holmes-The Tankerville Club Scandal
paragraphs: Captain Harry Prendergast is expelled from the Tankerville Club after marked cards are found in a poker game and an unopened deck appears in his pocket. Holmes recreates the game and exposes David Harkness, who used a bandaged finger to prick card values during play and framed Prendergast. Behind him is Alicia Wentworth's guardian, Colonel Sebastian Moran: Alicia's marriage would trigger an accounting of her trust, whose funds Moran has misused, so he arranged the scandal and a pistol duel intended to kill her suitor. Moran shoots Harkness when the accomplice threatens him, eliminating the witness. After Moran becomes involved in a new duel, Prendergast chooses boxing gloves and thrashes him. Holmes uses the financial secret to secure Moran's consent to the marriage.

grh_843660ddc8b8c503db15.title: Trade Winds
paragraphs: Private detective Sam Wye is sent across the Pacific to bring back fugitive Kay Kerrigan, who believes she murdered playboy Tommy Broome after he drove her sister to suicide. Sam falls for Kay and spots a crucial contradiction: Kay remembers shooting Broome in the heart, but he died from a bullet to the head, and a pair of black antelope gloves at the scene were not hers. Sam gathers the women linked to Broome and uses the gloves as bait; Mrs. Cornell claims them and finally admits that Kay's gun held blanks and that her husband Walden killed Broome after Kay left. With the confession secretly witnessed, Kay is cleared and Sam's pursuit ends in marriage rather than arrest.

grh_846ead48fec7baa8cf1a.title: Subject Number 428 A
paragraphs: Computer scientist Philo Benton claims that human beings have no free will and that a sufficiently complete computer record can predict every choice they will make. He proves his point with an astonishingly detailed forecast of Adam Gates's angry attempt to confound the machine, a confrontation that ends in Adam's death. Max Wilhite cannot accept a world in which every action is predetermined. He kills Benton, helps conceal what really happened and records a confession insisting that his unpredictable act was a blow for human freedom, even as the story leaves open whether that choice too might have been predictable.
